body:
This check reviews public documents for `G83` dwell (`P`) across the four named posts in issue #1820.

| Point | Finding | Source | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`: Fanuc mill `G83` `P` dwell | **Corrected.** The post writes `P<ms>` on `G83`. Published Fanuc mill `G83` formats list `X`, `Y`, `Z`, `R`, `Q`, `F`, and `K` without `P` (`G82` uses `P`). Helman CNC says: "G83 peck drilling cycle perform the drilling operation in multiple pecks". CNCzone mill users report that Fanuc controls ignore `P` in `G83` or raise an alarm. | FANUC Series 0i-MODEL F Operator's Manual `B-64604EN-2` and Series 0i-D `B-64304EN` (Machining Center `G83` format, indexed on `drivesul.com.br`); MRO Electric Fanuc manual mirror (`https://www.mroelectric.com/pdf/fanuc-i-o-manual-1.pdf`); Helman CNC *Fanuc G83 Peck Drilling Cycle* (`https://www.helmancnc.com/fanuc-g83-peck-drilling-cycle/`) and *Fanuc G82 Drilling Cycle* (`https://www.helmancnc.com/fanuc-g82-drilling-cycle/`); CNCzone (`cnczone.com`) Fanuc mill threads | Stated in the source |
| `assets/posts/haas.cps`: Haas mill `G83` `P` dwell and units | **Confirmed.** Haas mill `G83` reads `P` as bottom dwell: "P - The dwell time at the bottom of the hole". Without a decimal point, Haas reads `P` in milliseconds, so integer `P<ms>` is valid. Haas also keeps `P` modal across canned cycles. | Haas Automation *G83 Normal Peck Drilling Canned Cycle* (`https://www.haascnc.com/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=mill.value=G83.html`) and Haas `G04` Dwell documentation (`haascnc.com`) | Stated in the source |
| `assets/posts/mazak.cps`: Mazak EIA/ISO mill `G83` `P` dwell | **Corrected.** The post writes `P<ms>` on `G83`. The SmoothAi guide says: "Deep-hole (full-retract peck) drilling, Q = peck depth." The SmoothAi guide and Matrix 2 manual define `G83` with `X`, `Y`, `Z`, `R`, `Q`, and `F`, without `P`. `G82` uses `P`. Third-party blogs disagree and list an optional `P` on `G83`. | Zappettini Consulting *Mazak EIA/ISO (G-Code) Programming — MAZATROL SmoothAi* (`https://zappettiniconsulting.com/mazak-eia-iso-smoothai/`); *Manuel de programmation Mazatrol Matrix 2 (Centres d'usinage - Programme EIA/ISO)* `H740PB6042F` (`G83 Forage profond`, page 13-20, hosted on `free.fr`) and Matrix Parameter/Alarm list (*Fixed Cycle Format Error for G73/G83*); Victoria Caruk Mazak reference library (`https://victoriacaruk.com/`) | Stated in the source |
| `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`: Fanuc `0i` / `31i-M` baseline `G83` `P` dwell | **Corrected.** The post writes `P<ms>` on `G83`. `doosan-dnm.cps` targets Fanuc `0i` and `31i-M` controls and cites `B-64604EN-2/01`. Published Fanuc mill `G83` formats omit `P`. Public Doosan DNM `G83` examples also list `Z`, `R`, `Q`, and `F` without `P`. | FANUC Series 0i-MODEL F Operator's Manual `B-64604EN-2` (indexed on `drivesul.com.br`); Helman CNC (`https://www.helmancnc.com/fanuc-g83-peck-drilling-cycle/`); Doosan DNM `G83` examples (`cnctrainingcentre.com`, `machininganswers.com`) | Stated in the source; seen in an example program |
| `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`: DN Solutions OEM `MV0009OPE241_v0` override for `G83` | **Not found.** No public Doosan DNM manual explains OEM `G83` behavior without a distributor login or machine console USB. | DN Solutions document `MV0009OPE241_v0` (not publicly accessible without a distributor login or console USB) | Not found |

### Not found

- **Doosan / DN Solutions OEM `G83` specification (`MV0009OPE241_v0`):** Public searches found no accessible text copy of `MV0009OPE241_v0` without a distributor login.
- **Direct English OEM PDF URLs for Fanuc `B-64604EN-2` and Mazak Matrix/Smooth manuals:** Search snippets showed Fanuc `B-64604EN-2` on `drivesul.com.br` and Mazak `H740PB6042F` (French, page 13-20) on `free.fr`, without direct English OEM PDF URLs or Fanuc section page numbers.
- **OEM verification for third-party Mazak `G83` `P` claims:** No public Mazak OEM milling test confirms `P` support on `G83`.

### Suggested changes for the named post files (no code)

- **`assets/posts/fanuc.cps` (`onCycle`):** Do not write `P<ms>` on `G83`. Refuse a positive `G83` dwell by name with a clear message, so the post does not drop the dwell silently. Add a test for this refusal.
- **`assets/posts/haas.cps` (`onCycle` and `cycleSig`):** Keep integer `P<ms>` without a decimal point on `G83`, because Haas documents `P` dwell on `G83` in milliseconds. Add dwell to `cycleSig`, because `P` is modal in Haas canned cycles. If you omit dwell from `cycleSig`, a second hole with the same `Z`, `R`, and `Q` reuses the first hole's `P` value. Verify how the Haas control resets modal `P` when a later hole has zero dwell. Add tests for `G83` dwell output and dwell changes across holes.
- **`assets/posts/mazak.cps` (`onCycle`):** Do not write `P<ms>` on `G83`. Refuse a positive `G83` dwell by name until a test on a real Mazak control confirms `G83` dwell support. Add a test for this choice.
- **`assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` (`onCycle`):** Follow the published Fanuc `0i-F` (`B-64604EN-2/01`) format. Do not write `P<ms>` on `G83`, and refuse a positive `G83` dwell by name. Note in the file that public search did not verify Doosan OEM `MV0009OPE241_v0`. Add a test for this refusal.

**Real-control check required:** Check a real control before cutting. Test Fanuc `0i-MF`/`31i` parameter behavior, Mazak Smooth or Matrix `G83` dwell, Doosan DNM OEM firmware, and Haas modal `P` reset between holes.
